text.description_html:
Acorn PP3YP, 5-1/2" Hand Painted Ceramic Sea Grass Cabinet Pull

A beautiful addition to any home, the 5-1/2" Hand Painted Ceramic Sea Grass Cabinet Pull is available in yellow and gold, black and white, and light green and teal. Each is a hand painted work of art inspired by the sea to bring a sense of fluid movement your space. The Sea Grass Ceramic Pull can be mounted vertically or horizontally.

Also Available:
4-7/8" Blue Sea Grass Ceramic Cabinet Pull
Hand Painted Sea Grass Cabinet Knob

Features of the 5-1/2" Ceramic Sea Grass Cabinet Pull:

  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Length: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
